svg.title: A rectangular outline is V-scored; a curved one needs routing and tabs
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan views of two 80 by 70 mm panels with 10 mm rails. Left, marked right: four rectangular boards separated by V-score lines that run straight across the whole panel. Right: four round boards, each cut out by a 2 mm routed slot with round ends, and held to the panel by four tabs with mouse bites just inside the board edge.

g.text: ✓ Straight edges: V-scored edge to edge
Curved outline: routed slots and tabs
Runs straight across the whole panel
2 mm bit: round ends at each tab
Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
